name: assistive-navigation-client-tests
description: Test entry points for the browser navigation client. There is no build step and no runtime dependencies; the client is served as plain ES modules. This file only exists so `npm test` finds the Node test runner invocation.
//smoke: The smoke test drives the real page in a real browser and needs `npm i --no-save puppeteer-core` plus a local Chrome or Edge. It is deliberately not a saved dependency: the unit suite must stay installable with nothing at all.
